mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mega Gnar:</keywordMajor> Gnar leaps, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.GnarE:MegaTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies on landing. Enemies directly underneath are also briefly <status>Slowed</status> by @spell.GnarE:MoveSpeedMod*-100@%.

<keywordMajor>Mega Gnar:</keywordMajor> Gnar hurls a boulder, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.GnarQ:MegaTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by @spell.GnarQ:MegaSlowAmount*100@% for @spell.GnarQ:MegaSlowDuration@ seconds to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies. Picking up the boulder reduces this Ability's Cooldown by @spell.GnarQ:MegaCDRefund*100@%.

<keywordMajor>Mega Gnar:</keywordMajor> Gnar smashes an area, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.GnarW:MegaTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> for @spell.GnarW:MegaStunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Gnar leaps to a location and bounces off the head of any unit he lands on, traveling further.

Mega Gnar is too large to bounce and instead lands with earth-shattering force, dealing damage in an area around him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mini Gnar:</keywordMajor> Gnar leaps, gaining <attackSpeed>@spell.GnarE:MinibAS*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @spell.GnarE:MiniASDuration@ seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce off it, traveling further. Bouncing off an enemy deals <physicalDamage>@spell.GnarE:MiniTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by @spell.GnarE:MoveSpeedMod*-100@%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Excited</titleLeft><mainText>Gnar is enjoying himself and has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Enraged</titleLeft><mainText>Gnar is angry and on the brink of transforming.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Rage GeneGnar generates Rage while in combat and whenever he attacks. At max Rage his next ability will cause him to transform, modifying his abilities and stats for 15 seconds.

Mini Gnar: +@f1@ Move Speed, +@f2@ Range, +@f3@% Attack Speed.

Mega Gnar: +@f4@ Health, +@f5@ Armor, +@f6@ Magic Resist, and +@f7@ Base Attack Damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: While in combat Gnar generates Rage. At maximum Rage his next ability will transform him into Mega Gnar, granting increased survivability and access to new spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Gnar generates Rage by dealing and receiving damage. At max Rage his next Ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds.

Mini Gnar: Gain @TotalMS@ Move Speed, @TotalAS@ Attack Speed, and @TotalAttackRange@ Attack Range.

Mega Gnar: Gain @TotalMegaGnarHealth@ max Health, @TotalMegaGnarArmor@ Armor, @TotalMegaGnarMR@ Magic Resist, and @TotalMegaGnarAD@ Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{spell_GnarPassive_Tooltip}}

At max Rage, Gnar will automatically transform after 4 seconds if he does not use an Ability.
Rage decays after 13 seconds if Gnar has not dealt or received damage.
Rage gain is greater when dealing damage to champions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tired</titleLeft><mainText>Gnar is tired after raging out recently and is unable to generate Rage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Gnar throws a boomerang that damages and slows enemies it hits before returning to him. If he catches the boomerang its cooldown is reduced.

Mega Gnar instead throws a boulder that stops on the first unit hit, damaging and slowing everything nearby. It can then be picked up to reduce the cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mini Gnar:</keywordMajor> Gnar throws a boomerang that deals <physicalDamage>@spell.GnarQ:MiniTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Slows</status> by @spell.GnarQ:SlowAmount*100@% for @spell.GnarQ:SlowDuration@ seconds. The boomerang returns after hitting an enemy, dealing reduced damage to subsequent targets. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its Cooldown by @spell.GnarQ:MiniCDRefund*100@%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals @MiniSubsequentMult*100@% damage to enemies beyond the first.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Staggered</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed has been slowed after being clocked by Gnar's boomerang or boulder.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Mega Gnar throws everything around him in a chosen direction, dealing damage and slowing them.  Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed.

Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing @Damage@ physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by @RSlowPercent@% for @RCCDuration@ seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take @WallDamage@ physical damage and are Stunned.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>After transforming to <keywordMajor>Mini Gnar</keywordMajor>, Gnar cannot gain <keywordMajor>Rage</keywordMajor> for 15 seconds.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Wrekz'd</titleLeft><mainText>Gnar got mad and knocked this unit into the air.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Wrekz'd</titleLeft><mainText>Gnar got mad and knocked this unit into the air.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stunned</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is stunned. It can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Gnar's attacks and spells hype him up, dealing bonus damage and granting him Move Speed.

Mega Gnar is too enraged to be hyper and instead can rear up on his hind legs and smash down on the area in front of him, stunning enemies in an area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mini Gnar Passive:</keywordMajor> Every third Attack or Ability on the same enemy deals an additional <magicDamage>@spell.GnarW:MiniTotalDamage@ plus @spell.GnarW:MiniPercentHPDamage*100@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and grants <speed>@spell.GnarR:RHyperMovementSpeedPercent@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @spell.GnarW:MiniHasteDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Gnar also gains the Move Speed when he leaves Mega Gnar form.
Deals a max of @MiniMonsterCap@ magic damage against jungle monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Hyper</titleLeft><mainText>If Gnar hits this unit three times he will deal bonus damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
